address: Spinoza Lyceum, Peter van Anrooystraat 8, Amsterdam (built 1957): a white concrete-frame school, four-storey south-east wing with orange timber window panels under awnings over a low band of grid windows, a stair and canopy entrance, and a three-storey west wing of eleven timber-framed bays
notes: Spinoza Lyceum (BAG pand 0363100012129398, built 1957, 113 3DBAG wall surfaces, roof max 18.3 m), Peter van Anrooystraat 8 (the OSM node; schools.json's earlier Spinozastraat 41 was a residential address). White concrete frame with orange timber window panels: walls[0] = the 74 m south-east wing (panels 68 and 80, surfaces 85 and 106, w01-156, 2024) with an entrance under a concrete canopy plate SPINOZA; walls[1] = the west wing (panel 85, surface 112, w02-252, 2016), 11 bays.

Simplified: awnings (temporary), stair flights, solid timber parapet boards; two-light windows on the south-east wing keep the triangle count under 12k (wide windows were 12.1k); the other wings and the rear walls had no panorama or are not photographed and stay blank.
